schema.title: AccountsNumberInput

The input of `accounts.archive`, `accounts.restore` and `accounts.get`:
the account number (from the path).

schema.description: The output of the four writes: the account after the change.

schema.title: AccountsCreateInput
schema.description: The input of `accounts.create`. `type` is the account class.

number.description: The account number: 2 to 10 ASCII digits, unique in the chart.

name.description: The name shown for the account (a custom name).

type.description: The account class: asset, liability, equity, income or expense.

parent.description: The parent account number; absent means the root of the chart.

currency.description: The account's currency code; absent means the company base currency.

schema.title: AccountsChangedOutput
schema.description: The output of the four writes: the account after the change.

schema.title: AccountsGetOutput
schema.description: The output of `accounts.get`: the account and its recent activity.

activity.description: The most recent entries touching the account, newest first.

schema.description:
The input of `accounts.archive`, `accounts.restore` and `accounts.get`:
the account number (from the path).

schema.title: AccountsChangedOutput

schema.title: AccountsUpdateInput
schema.description:
The input of `accounts.update`. `number` comes from the path. Only the
fields present change; `clear_parent` moves the account to the root.

type.description: A new class; refused once the account has postings or children.

tags.description: A new tag list, replacing the old one.

clear_parent.description: Move the account to the root of the chart.

schema.description: The output of the four writes: the account after the change.

schema.title: AgreementsCreateInput
schema.description: Input of `agreements.create`. The server fills in `id` and `created_by`.

id.description: The agreement id; the server fills it in when empty.

group_id.description: The group both companies belong to.

licensor_company_id.description: The company that owns the rights and receives the income.

licensee_company_id.description: The company that pays and books the expense.

basis.description: How the period amount is worked out.

rate_bp.description: The rate in basis points, for the percentage bases.

fixed_minor.description: The fixed monthly amount in minor units, for the fixed basis.

currency.description: The currency: the base currency of both companies.

treaty_override_bp.description: A treaty rate in basis points that replaces the country pack's rate.

created_by.description: Who creates it; the server fills it in.

schema.title: AgreementsCreateOutput
schema.description: Output of `agreements.create`: both sides, as their companies hold them.

schema.title: AgreementsListOutput
schema.description: Output of `agreements.list`: the company's own side of each agreement.

schema.title: AgreementsGetOutput
schema.description: Output of `agreements.get`: the company's side and its period documents.

agreement.description: The company's side of the agreement.

periods.description: The company's documents, one per period.

id.description: The agreement id, from the path.

periods.description: The periods, each `YYYY-MM`, posted or settled in order.

schema.title: PeriodsOutput
schema.description:
Output of `agreements.post_period` and `agreements.settle_period`: the
documents of each period, licensor first.

periods.description: One entry per period, in the order given.

id.description: The agreement id, from the path.

schema.title: RunPeriodOutput
schema.description: Output of `agreements.run_period`: the documents of each period, both sides.

periods.description: The documents per period, licensor first.

id.description: The agreement id, from the path.

periods.description: The periods, each `YYYY-MM`, posted or settled in order.

schema.title: PeriodsOutput
schema.description:
Output of `agreements.post_period` and `agreements.settle_period`: the
documents of each period, licensor first.

periods.description: One entry per period, in the order given.

id.description: The agreement id, from the path.

The input of `allocation_rules.set`: the rules replace the old set, and the
unposted drafts of the connection are re-split under them.

default_unit.description: A new default unit, when given.

kept_frozen.description: Posted or discarded bills whose split stays as it was.

schema.title: ApprovalSettingsView
schema.description: The approval rules the Settings screen edits.

low_risk_limits.description:
Per-currency amount (major units, canonical) at or below which a money
request is low risk and may be approved in bulk.

request_ttl_hours.description: How long a request waits for a decision before it expires.

fresh_sign_in_minutes.description:
The sign-in window high-risk approvals need. Fixed by the approvals
crate, shown so the rule is visible.

low_risk_limits.description: Per-currency low-risk limits, in canonical amounts.

schema.description: The approval rules the Settings screen edits.

low_risk_limits.description:
Per-currency amount (major units, canonical) at or below which a money
request is low risk and may be approved in bulk.

request_ttl_hours.description: How long a request waits for a decision before it expires.

fresh_sign_in_minutes.description:

next_before_seq.description: Pass as `before_seq` to get the next page; null when there is no more.

schema.title: AccountView
schema.description: A bank account as the app shows it, with its reconciliation summary.

name.description: The name a person gave it.

opening.description: The opening balance the account was set up with.

opening_date.description: The date of the opening balance.

csv_mapping.description: The saved CSV column mapping, when one is set.

archived.description: Whether the account is archived (no more imports or postings).

statement_balance.description: The closing balance of the latest imported statement, when there is one.

ledger_balance.description: The balance of the linked ledger account, as of the statement date.

difference.description: Statement balance minus ledger balance; zero when no statement is imported.

matched_count.description: Lines matched to a journal entry or a bill.

ignored_count.description: Lines a person chose to leave out of the books.

name.description: The name a person gives the account.

iban.description: The IBAN, validated with its check digits.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency of the account.

ledger_account_number.description: The linked ledger account; it must carry the `bank` tag.

opening_amount.description: The opening balance as decimal text in the account currency, e.g. `1250.00`.

opening_date.description: The date of the opening balance, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

csv_mapping.description: A CSV column mapping for this account's exports.

schema.title: ReconciliationView
schema.description: The reconciliation of an account as of a date.

as_of.description: The date the balances are compared at.

statement_balance.description: The statement's closing balance at that date (the opening balance when no statement has been imported).

ledger_balance.description: The ledger's balance of the linked account at that date.

unmatched_total.description: The part of the difference explained by unmatched lines.

ignored_total.description: The part explained by lines the person chose to ignore.

residual.description: The rest: entries on the account that no statement line explains.

reconciled.description: Whether nothing is left unexplained and no line is unmatched.

bic.description: A new BIC; an empty string clears it.

schema.title: ReceivablesOpenItemsOutput
schema.description: Output of `bank.receivables.open_items`: the customer's open receivables, oldest first.

account_number.description: The account the rule posts to (postable, not a bank account).

schema.title: RuleView
schema.description: A bank rule as the app shows it.

name.description: The name a person gave it.

account_number.description: The account the rule posts to.

enabled.description: Whether it applies. An agent's rule waits here until a person enables it.

schema.title: StatementsImportRequest
schema.description:
The public request of `bank.statements.import`: the document is read by
the server, which parses it and fills the command's statements itself.

account_id.description: The bank account the statement is for.

format.description: The format; detected from the bytes when omitted.

statements.description: One summary per statement in the file.

new_transactions.description: Lines stored by this import, over all statements.

duplicate_transactions.description: Lines already stored, over all statements.

matched_entry_id.description: The entry it is matched to, when linked.

schema.title: TransactionsLinkInput
schema.description: `bank.transactions.link`: match the line to an entry already posted.

entry_id.description: The posted entry, with one line on the bank's ledger account of the same amount.

matched_entry_id.description: The entry it is matched to, when linked.

next.description: The cursor for the next page, when there is one.

schema.title: TransactionsPostInput
schema.description: `bank.transactions.post`: post the line as a journal entry.

counterparty_account.description: The account the other side of the entry goes to. Give this or `bill_id`.

bill_id.description: An open bill this line pays. Give this or `counterparty_account`.

tax_code.description: The tax code on the counterparty line.

unit.description: The unit (dimension) on the counterparty line.

journal_id.description: The journal; the general journal `GN` when omitted.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year; the booking date's year when omitted.

party_id.description:
The customer a receipt is from. Required when the counterparty is a
receivables account; the receipt settles that customer's open items.

open_item_ids.description:
The customer's open items the receipt settles, in the order to settle
them. When omitted, the customer's oldest open items are settled first.
Any amount beyond them becomes an on-account item for the customer.

schema.title: ConfirmInput
schema.description: Input of `bills.confirm`: a person confirms the vendor and the IBAN of a bill.

schema.title: BillInput
schema.description:
The input of `bills.create`, and of `bills.update` (where the bill id comes
from the path and the document stays as it was). The id and the document
are filled by the server on create.

id.description: The new bill's id (server-generated on create).

document_id.description: The document the bill is for (create only).

vendor_id.description:
The party the bill is for, picked by a person. When set it is used as
is (it must be an unmerged party of the company); otherwise the vendor
is matched by VAT id, then by name.

vendor_iban.description: The IBAN printed on the invoice.

confidence.description: Confidence per extracted field, 0 to 100 (empty for manual bills).

reader.description:
Which reader produced the fields: `rules`, `anthropic`, `minimax`, or
`unread-scan` for a scanned PDF no configured reader takes. Filled by
the server from the extraction.

created_by.description: The caller, recorded on the bill (filled by the server).

unit.description:
The business unit the bill's expense lines belong to. Required to post
once the company has units; ignored while it has none.

schema.title: ExtractInput
schema.description:
`bills.extract`'s gate and reader: the caller needs the draft tier, and
the document must be stored.

journal_id.description: The journal to post into; defaults to the general journal `GN`.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year; defaults to the year of the posting date.

schema.title: ProposeEntryOutput
schema.description: The lines a bill would post as, with VAT and AP on specific accounts.

lines.description: The balanced lines, in the same format as a preview.

schema.title: RecordPaymentInput
schema.description: Input of `bills.record-payment`: the bill id and payment details.

amount.description: The amount paid, in minor units.

from_account.description: The bank account to credit, postable and tagged "bank".

reference.description: Optional reference text for the payment.

schema.title: UpdateInput
schema.description: Input of `bills.update`: the bill id and the corrected fields.

id.description: The new bill's id (server-generated on create).

document_id.description: The document the bill is for (create only).

vendor_id.description:
The party the bill is for, picked by a person. When set it is used as
is (it must be an unmerged party of the company); otherwise the vendor
is matched by VAT id, then by name.

vendor_iban.description: The IBAN printed on the invoice.

confidence.description: Confidence per extracted field, 0 to 100 (empty for manual bills).

reader.description:
Which reader produced the fields: `rules`, `anthropic`, `minimax`, or
`unread-scan` for a scanned PDF no configured reader takes. Filled by
the server from the extraction.

created_by.description: The caller, recorded on the bill (filled by the server).

unit.description:
The business unit the bill's expense lines belong to. Required to post
once the company has units; ignored while it has none.

base_currency_locked.description: True once the company has an entry: the base currency can no longer change.
True once the company has an entry: the base currency can no longer change.

schema.title: CreateInput
schema.description:
The input of `connections.create`. `sealed_credential` is filled by the
server from the token it received; a client that sends it is overwritten.

name.description: The name the company gives it.

config.description: The non-secret settings for the connector.

default_unit.description: The unit that receives unmapped resources.

demo.description:
Demo connections hold no token: they sync from recorded fixtures. Only
the demo seeder sets it (server-filled, false for every client).

token.description:
The token, as the client sends it. The server seals it and removes this
field before the command runs, so it is never in the executor's input.

schema.title: ConnectionView
schema.description:
A connection as the books see it. The credential is never in it: only
whether one is held.

name.description: The name the company gave it.

default_unit.description: The unit that receives unmapped resources.

is_demo.description: Whether it is demo data (recorded fixtures, no tokens).

has_credential.description: Whether a token is held (the token itself is never shown).

disconnected.description: Always true when the plan runs.

schema.title: SuspenseRebookInput
schema.description:
The input of `connections.suspense_rebook`: a journal entry a ledger connector posted to
the suspense account, and the account its suspense amount moves to.

connection_id.description: The connection the entry came from.

entry_id.description: The journal entry that holds the suspense amount.

to_account.description: The account the suspense amount is re-booked to. A leaf of the chart.

entry.description: The posted entry with its assigned number.

schema.title: SyncInput
schema.description:
The input of `connections.sync_now`. The server fills `run_id`, `created_by`
and exactly one of `fetched` (the vendor's answer) or `fetch_error`.

since.description: The first day of the window, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

until.description: The last day of the window, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

fetch_error.description: Why the vendor could not be read (server-filled).

ledger_links.description:
The journal entries the server posted for this sync's planned entries, to
record against their provider ids (server-filled).

schema.title: RunView
schema.description: One sync run, as the history shows it.

invoices_found.description: Invoices the vendor returned in the window.

schema.title: TestInput
schema.description: The input of `connections.test`: the connection to try.

connection_id.description: The connection whose credential is tried.

schema.title: TestOutput
schema.description:
The output of `connections.test`. Nothing is written: the test reads the
vendor for the current day and reports whether the credential and its scope
work. `error` is set when they do not, with no credential in it.

ok.description: Whether the vendor answered for the test window.

notes.description: What the vendor said about the test, as sentences.

error.description: Why the test failed, when it failed.

schema.title: UpdateInput
schema.description:
The input of `connections.update`. Every field is optional; a sealed
credential is written only when the server fills it (a token was sent).

config.description: A new config (replaces the old one).

token.description:
A new token, as the client sends it: sealed and removed by the server
before the command runs, the same as on create.

schema.title: ConnectionView
schema.description:
A connection as the books see it. The credential is never in it: only
whether one is held.

name.description: The name the company gave it.

default_unit.description: The unit that receives unmapped resources.

is_demo.description: Whether it is demo data (recorded fixtures, no tokens).

has_credential.description: Whether a token is held (the token itself is never shown).

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the deleted document's blob (for garbage collection).

mime.description: The MIME type of the deleted document (for re-storing the blob if concurrent upload sees it missing).

schema.title: DocumentUrlOutput
schema.description: The output of `documents.download_url`: a relative link and its expiry.

url.description: The link, relative to the API origin.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working (Unix seconds).

anchors.description: The anchors to set (replaces existing ones).

schema.title: EntryRecordView
schema.description: One posted entry, as the app's `EntryRecord` types it.

external_id.description: The source application's idempotency key, if it gave one.

fiscal_year.description: The fiscal year its number is scoped to.

number.description: The gapless number within the journal and fiscal year.

posted_by.description: Who posted it: `agent` (an agent key) or `person`.

reverses.description: The entry this one reverses, when it is a reversal.

reversed_by.description: The entry that reverses this one, if any.

schema.title: EntriesPostInput
schema.description:
The input of `entries.post`: a balanced entry and, optionally, the
journal and fiscal year to post it to (defaults: journal `GN`, and the
fiscal year of the posting date).

journal_id.description: The journal to post into; defaults to the general journal `GN`.

fiscal_year.description:
The fiscal year the entry number is scoped to; defaults to the
posting date's year.

entry.description: The entry: header, dates and lines.
The posted entry with its assigned number.

schema.title: EntriesReverseInput
schema.description:
The input of `entries.reverse`: the external id of the entry to reverse
(from the path) and the posting date of the reversal (default: today).

external_id.description: The `external_id` the reversed entry was posted with.

posting_date.description: The reversal's posting date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; defaults to today (UTC).

entry.description: The posted entry with its assigned number.

schema.title: EntriesTransferInput
schema.description:
The input of `entries.transfer`: a shared-cost recharge from one unit to
another. Amounts are in the company's base currency.

journal_id.description: The journal; defaults to the general journal `GN`.

from_unit.description: The unit that paid the shared cost and recovers it.

to_unit.description: The unit the cost is recharged to.

amount.description: The amount, positive, in the base currency.

tax_point_date.description: The tax point date; defaults to the posting date.

recovery_account.description: The income account on the paying unit that books the recovery.

cost_account.description: The expense account on the receiving unit that books the cost.

entry.description: The posted entry with its assigned number.

closing_entry_id.description: The closing entry the year-end close posted, when there was a result to close.

label.description: The calendar year to open (January to December).
The year's label (its calendar year, for a January start).

starts_on.description: The first day of the year.

ends_on.description: The last day of the year.

closed.description: True once the year-end close has run.

id.description: The group id; the server fills it in when empty.

members.description: The members: at least two companies.

created_by.description: Who creates it; the server fills it in.

schema.title: GroupView
schema.description: One group as a read returns it. Members the person may not see are left out.

members.description: The members the person may see.

has_hidden_members.description: True when some member is not shown to the person.

logo_document_id.description: The logo document, when the group has one.

logo_company_id.description:
The company whose documents hold the logo: a member reads it with this
company as the request's company.

groups.description: The groups the company belongs to.

schema.title: GroupsUpdateInput
schema.description: Input of `groups.update`: a new name and, when given, the whole member list.

id.description: The group id, from the path.

members.description: The new member list, replacing the old one; at least two companies.

logo_document_id.description:
A stored image document (PNG or JPEG, at most 2 MiB) to use as the logo.
The server checks it before the command runs.

schema.title: GroupView
schema.description: One group as a read returns it. Members the person may not see are left out.

members.description: The members the person may see.

has_hidden_members.description: True when some member is not shown to the person.

logo_document_id.description: The logo document, when the group has one.

logo_company_id.description:
The company whose documents hold the logo: a member reads it with this
company as the request's company.

name.description: A label for the key, shown in the app and the audit trail.

limits.description:
Per-currency limits, keyed by ISO 4217 code. A currency with no entry
is not allowed at all (fail closed).

unit.description:
Pin the key to one business unit: its entries carry that unit, and it
may post to no other. Absent means all units.

schema.title: KeysCreateOutput
schema.description: Output of `keys.create`: the key, and its full token, shown once.

token.description: The full bearer token. It is not stored and cannot be shown again.

keys.description: Every agent key of the company, revoked ones included.

schema.title: KeysRevokeInput
schema.description: Input of `keys.revoke`: the key's `id`, as `keys.list` returns it.

next_number.description: The number the next entry receives. Must be above the current next number.
The number the next entry receives. Must be above the current next number.

balances.description:
One row per party and currency with an open payable; parties with
nothing open are absent.

country_code.description: The country code (e.g. `DE`, `FR`); must be a VIES member state.

vat_number.description:
The VAT number without its country prefix. Together they must be the
party's VAT ID.

id.description: The party id (generated by server if empty).

vat_id.description: The VAT id (optional), checked against its country's pack.

personal_data.description: Whether this party's name/addresses/contacts is personal data (default false).

schema.title: ListOutput
schema.description: The output of `parties.list`: one page, and the count of every match.

total.description: Total number of unmerged parties that match the filters.

party.description: The party, with its latest VIES result and possible duplicates.

bill_count.description: How many bills name this party (a merge repoints them to the survivor).

vies_enabled.description: Whether `parties.check_vat` can call VIES on this server (`LEDGERS_VIES=1`).

id.description: The surviving party id (from the path).

iban.description: The new IBAN; checked for country length and mod-97.

reason.description: Why the details changed (kept in the history).

party.description: The party with its new bank details.

vat_id.description: The VAT id (optional), checked against its country's pack. Blank clears it.

addresses.description: Postal addresses; when given, they replace the list (optional).

contacts.description: Contacts; when given, they replace the list (optional).

schema.title: ValidateInput
schema.description:
The input of `parties.validate`: the fields a form holds. A field left out
is not checked; a blank name or VAT ID that is sent is checked.

id.description: The party being edited, so its own VAT ID is not a conflict (optional).

vat_id.description: The VAT ID, checked against its country's pack and the other parties.

valid.description: True when no field is refused.

schema.title: PeriodView
schema.description: One period of a fiscal year and its state.

reason.description: Why the month is reopened. Written to the audit trail.

schema.title: PeriodView
schema.description: One period of a fiscal year and its state.

equity_accounts.description: The equity accounts alone (capital, reserves, retained earnings).

current_year_result.description:
Income minus expenses from the fiscal year start up to `as_of`
(Jahresüberschuss, or Jahresfehlbetrag when negative).

difference.description: Assets minus liabilities minus equity. Zero when `balanced`.

balanced.description: Whether the sheet balances on its own: assets = liabilities + equity.

lines.description: The lines, by month, unit and source.

members.description: The members the person may see, side by side.
